attested.description: True when the head commit carries a well-formed attestation note. It says nothing about whether the note verifies; see note_verified.
attested.title: Attested

chain_status.description: The event log's hash chain: intact, broken, unchained, empty, or unreadable.
chain_status.title: Chain Status

findings_by_status.description: The run's findings counted by status.
findings_by_status.title: Findings By Status

local_details.description: True when the report includes local paths and user-level configuration.
local_details.title: Local Details

needs_human.description: True once the run hit the restart limit and needs a person.
needs_human.title: Needs Human

note_verified.description: True when that note verifies in this clone, as `verify` decides; false when it does not; null when there is no note or the check could not run.
note_verified.title: Note Verified

path.description: Where the HTML report was written.
path.title: Path

run_selection.description: How the run was chosen: selected (--run), active, or most_recent.
run_selection.title: Run Selection

size_bytes.description: Size of the report in bytes.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

telemetry.description: Summary outcome written when this command ended a run.
telemetry.title: Telemetry
